# Card

Display elements and features related to one subject on a flexible container.
See [Card guidelines<i className="ds-icon-launch"></i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/card/design/)

<Source code="import { Card } from &#x22;@airbus/components-react&#x22;" />

<Primary />

<Controls />

- Any other props supplied will be provided to the root element
- For details on CSS styles, see [CSS implementation](https://github.airbus.corp/Airbus/design-system/blob/develop/packages/styles/src/elements/Card/index.ts)

### Actionable

You can add an `onClick` event handler to a `Card`.

#### Action Area

You can also use `CardActionArea` to restrict the onClick to a zone of the card.
